## Example 1.5 · The original price {#fm1-example-1-5 .fm-slide }

After a 10% discount the price is \$495. What was the original price?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 4 · Example 1.5 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
Let the original price be $x$. Then $0.9x=495$, giving $x=495/0.9=550$. The original price was \$550. Check $550(0.9)=495$.
:::
